draft.emotion: energetic and confident, standing tall and ready for action
notes: Khỏe is very flexible. It describes both a state of being healthy (not sick) and having significant physical strength.
When used in greetings, it is the standard way to ask if someone is well, though it specifically refers to health rather than overall happiness.

senses.definition: Having great physical power and muscle strength.

examples.emotion: impressed and admiring, observing someone's physical capability
